QuestInfo.name: [Alliance Mission] Expedition Mission - Light of Judgment
QuestInfo.1:
Many Expedition members are falling victim to the giant's Light of Judgment attacks. #bYou should avoid the Light of Judgment at all costs.#k After completing your objective, report to #b#p3003564##k to complete the mission.

The Light of Judgment is used #roften#k by the giant, and it wipes out your health in a single strike. #bMove carefully#k to avoid these attacks. Although the Light of Judgment can be partially blocked with #bErda#k collected from eliminating monsters, it's best to avoid getting hit so that your Erda can be used to block the Light of Annihilation.

#rThis mission is extremely difficult and dangerous. Be especially wary of the giant's Light of Annihilation and Light of Judgment attacks.#k
QuestInfo.2: You avoided the Light of Judgment and completed the Expedition Mission.
